description: Alluvioni_Elementi_a_Rischio is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pcn.minambiente.it. The dataset represents the national patchwork of the elements at risk in which the potential negative consequences of floods are indicated in the three scenarios provided for in Article 6 of Directive 2007/60/EC (Floods Directive): high probability (H), mean probability (M) and low probability (L) of occurrence. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Floods_Elementi_a_Risk" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Elementi a Rischio, Direttiva 2007/60, Suolo, Zone a rischio naturale, Idrografia, Pericolosità. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
